zoho-1-crm-basics.q: What happens when you convert a Lead in Zoho CRM?
options: The Lead is deleted with no new records
It becomes a Contact (and optionally an Account and a Deal)
zoho-1-crm-basics.correct: It becomes a Contact (and optionally an Account and a Deal)
zoho-1-crm-basics.explanation: Conversion creates Contact/Account and optionally a Deal.

zoho-1-crm-basics.q: Where do you check new Zoho CRM features so you don't report them as bugs?
options: The monthly "What's New in Zoho CRM" roundup
Nowhere; new buttons are always bugs
zoho-1-crm-basics.correct: The monthly "What's New in Zoho CRM" roundup

zoho-1-crm-basics.q: Practice for this track happens in the sandbox / test account, never on real client records without approval.
zoho-1-crm-basics.explanation: Golden rule of the Zoho track.

zoho-2-records-pipelines.q: Why can a layout make a field mandatory only at certain stages?
options: So each stage captures the data it needs before the deal moves on
zoho-2-records-pipelines.correct: So each stage captures the data it needs before the deal moves on

zoho-2-records-pipelines.q: What decides which leads get called first?
options: Lead scoring (plus how new the lead is)
zoho-2-records-pipelines.correct: Lead scoring (plus how new the lead is)

zoho-2-records-pipelines.q: Why might one Zoho org have several pipelines?
options: To separate different processes or clients (e.g. one per BPO client)
zoho-2-records-pipelines.correct: To separate different processes or clients (e.g. one per BPO client)
zoho-2-records-pipelines.explanation: Pipelines map to distinct sales processes.

zoho-3-activities.q: Which three activity types do you create when setting appointments?
zoho-3-activities.explanation: Schedule calls, log outcomes, create meetings with reminders.

zoho-3-activities.q: After an outbound call you log the outcome and schedule the follow-up in Zoho.
zoho-3-activities.explanation: If it's not in Zoho, it didn't happen.

zoho-3-activities.q: A booked appointment should be a Meeting linked to the Lead/Deal with a reminder.
zoho-3-activities.explanation: That's the record the team and automations rely on.

zoho-4-data-quality.q: How many records can you merge at once, and can a merge be undone?
options: 10, and yes it can be undone
Up to 3, and merges are irreversible
zoho-4-data-quality.correct: Up to 3, and merges are irreversible
zoho-4-data-quality.explanation: That's why you review before merging and ask when in doubt.

options: Last 10 digits of the phone or email, never by name
zoho-4-data-quality.correct: Last 10 digits of the phone or email, never by name
zoho-4-data-quality.explanation: Many same-name records are different people.

zoho-4-data-quality.q: Which is a good daily QA view?
zoho-4-data-quality.explanation: QA queues catch stale leads and stuck deals.

zoho-4-data-quality.q: Before an import, you choose how duplicates are handled during field mapping.

zoho-5-automation.q: What's the difference between a workflow rule and a blueprint?
options: A workflow rule fires actions automatically on a trigger; a blueprint enforces the process step by step through transitions
zoho-5-automation.correct: A workflow rule fires actions automatically on a trigger; a blueprint enforces the process step by step through transitions
zoho-5-automation.explanation: Know what touches a record before editing it.

options: Automated follow-up sequences of emails, calls and tasks
zoho-5-automation.correct: Automated follow-up sequences of emails, calls and tasks
zoho-5-automation.explanation: GSD uses them for nurture; you enrol/unenrol and QA them.

zoho-5-automation.q: Before editing a record, you check which rules, blueprint or cadence affect it.

zoho-6-campaigns.q: Why do we never send a campaign to a purchased list?
options: Zoho's anti-spam policy requires permission-based email; violations can suspend the account
Purchased lists are always in Spanish
zoho-6-campaigns.correct: Zoho's anti-spam policy requires permission-based email; violations can suspend the account
zoho-6-campaigns.explanation: Opt-in, unsubscribe link, no purchased lists.

zoho-6-campaigns.q: A contact replied STOP or unsubscribed but is still on a list. What do you do?
options: Leave them; one more email is fine
Remove/suppress them and mark the opt-out in the CRM the same day
Move them to a different list
zoho-6-campaigns.correct: Remove/suppress them and mark the opt-out in the CRM the same day

zoho-6-campaigns.q: Which number in a campaign report warns you of a deliverability problem?
zoho-6-campaigns.explanation: High bounces/complaints hurt the sending domain.

zoho-6-campaigns.q: Test sends of a campaign draft go only to internal addresses.
zoho-6-campaigns.explanation: Then the review copy waits for your manager's explicit OK.

zoho-7-flow.q: What is a trigger in Zoho Flow?
options: The event that starts a flow (e.g. an app event, a schedule or a webhook)
zoho-7-flow.correct: The event that starts a flow (e.g. an app event, a schedule or a webhook)

zoho-7-flow.q: A customer booked in Bookings but doesn't appear in CRM. Where do you look first?
options: The flow's run history, to find the step that failed
zoho-7-flow.correct: The flow's run history, to find the step that failed
zoho-7-flow.explanation: History/logs show where a run failed.

zoho-7-flow.q: The path is: Bookings booking → Flow → CRM record and meeting.

zoho-8-bookings.q: Where do you confirm, reschedule and mark no-shows?
What do you send a lead so they can self-book?
zoho-8-bookings.explanation: Customers can book from the website/booking page.

zoho-8-bookings.q: Website chats from SalesIQ can become Leads in the CRM.
zoho-8-bookings.explanation: Know where they land and how they convert.
